**Finding: deviation (Section 19, ¶p0133) — redline validated and submitted.**

- **Issue:** The clause is a mutual **no-hire**, not a non-solicit, and on its natural reading covers **any employee** of the other party (the "directly involved in the provision of services" qualifier attaches only to the ex-employee prong). It also lacks any general-advertising or unsolicited-approach carve-out.
- **Why it fails the fallback:** No-hire provisions and restrictions covering all personnel are walk-away items under NOSOLICIT; the missing carve-outs compound this. The one-year duration is acceptable, and Section 18 confirms the covenant survives termination against us.
- **Fix (fallback level, per redline guidance):** Narrowed to a solicitation-only, mutual restriction limited to personnel directly involved in the services, running 12 months from the end of that involvement, with express general-advertising and unsolicited-approach carve-outs and confirmation that hiring is not restricted.
